title: Why The World Has Never Had This Many Displaced People
hook: Your world now holds 123.2 million people displaced from home.
closing: Every year now breaks the record before the last one.
question: Which country hosts the most refugees?

segments.say: More people are displaced right now, 123.2 million, than at any point ever recorded.
Iran alone hosts nearly 3.5 million refugees, more than any other country.
Low and middle income countries host 73 percent of the world's displaced people.
